referencePolicy: Each call receives only the explicitly listed already-inspected local references. inputRole: Use case: stylized-concept. The supplied local images are already-inspected production-finish references only. Create one new original canonical named character; do not edit, combine, trace or copy their face, pose, costume or form-specific props.
commonDirection: Asset type: canonical individual named-character production concept master for later 3D design. assets.name: Enoch Vale

canonical.role: Mortal organizer of roads between cosmic front lines
canonical.desire: Keep one ordinary evening routine alive long enough to outlast prophecy.
canonical.fear: Becoming important enough that strangers die for his decisions.
canonical.contradiction: He refuses cosmic sacrifice in public while maintaining a private list of settlements he would abandon first.
canonical.secret: His plain oil lamp contains a captive Synod intelligence that advises him with perfect, merciless forecasts.
canonical.visualBrief: Weathered civic lamplighter carrying a ladder-staff and shuttered black lantern; entirely mortal silhouette, except six thin angelic fingers occasionally press against the lamp glass from within.

assets.masterDirection: Show exactly one complete weathered mortal civic lamplighter, Enoch Vale, with an entirely ordinary human-derived body: one head, two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Dress him in repaired rain-dark municipal workwear with practical straps and restrained aged brass fittings, never priestly, royal or armored. He carries EXACTLY ONE long ladder-staff as a maintenance tool and EXACTLY ONE plain shuttered black oil lantern, both complete and separately readable. The lantern is the only supernatural object. Behind its closed glass, show EXACTLY SIX and only six long thin pale angelic fingers pressing outward from within; the fingers belong to no visible hand, body, face or angel, never breach the glass, and remain countable through the shutters. Keep the lantern black, compact and otherwise plain, with no halo or external aura. Both of Enoch's own mortal hands remain anatomically clear while holding or securing the two tools. Full boots, staff tip, lantern handle and every finger stay inside frame with black clearance. No second lamp, flame creature, angel body, wing, halo, prophecy page, settlement list, readable mark, street, floor or scene.

assets.name: Sister Calve

canonical.role: Physician treating angelic purification and demonic adaptation alike
canonical.fear: That triage will train her to mistake efficiency for justice.
canonical.contradiction: She treats any wounded being, but sells tomorrow's patient order to whichever faction supplies medicine today.
canonical.secret: Her hospice is slowly becoming a new neutral organism assembled from discarded angel and demon tissue.
canonical.visualBrief: Mortal field surgeon in layered gray hospice cloth, bearing one sealed gold wing splint and one black-nacre rib brace as tools rather than trophies.

assets.masterDirection: Show exactly one complete mortal field surgeon, Sister Calve, with mature human anatomy, a visible compassionate but exhausted face, two ordinary arms and hands, and two fully framed legs and boots. Dress her only in layered weathered gray hospice cloth, practical wraps, repaired leather and a compact field-care harness; no ceremonial habit, halo, winged body or armor silhouette. She bears EXACTLY TWO extraordinary treatment tools: EXACTLY ONE sealed sunless-gold wing splint and EXACTLY ONE black-nacre rib brace. The gold splint is one closed folded medical brace shaped to immobilize a wing but contains no wing, feathers or occupant. Carry both as clearly separate sanitized tools on her harness or in her hands, never trophies, weapons, implants or body growths. Keep her ordinary hands countable and her care equipment subordinate. No patient, bed, hospital room, angel, demon, severed part, blood, second splint, second brace, medicine label, religious mark, floor or scene.

canonical.fear: That every safeguard is simply a better weapon waiting for an owner.
canonical.contradiction: He deserted to prevent divine authoritarianism, yet compulsively designs systems only he can control.

canonical.visualBrief: Mortal engineer in scorched ceremonial under-armor with a dismantled halo worn as a tool harness; one eye reflects dawn, the other retains natural darkness.
